articles.headline: US Regulators Open Investigation Into Tesla’s Cybercab Certification
articles.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an investigation into whether Tesla properly certified its autonomous Cybercab robotaxi. The case could affect autonomous vehicle timelines, compliance costs, and broader confidence in commercial deployment of self-driving services.

articles.headline: Nvidia Acquires Hugging Face
articles.summary: Nvidia’s reported $13 billion acquisition of Hugging Face signals a deeper push to control the AI software stack, not just chips. For businesses, this could influence model deployment choices, vendor lock-in risk, and the economics of enterprise AI adoption.

articles.headline: TSMC Says It Still Cannot Keep Up With AI Boom Despite Fivefold Capacity Expansion
articles.summary: TSMC said demand from the AI boom remains ahead of its expanded manufacturing plans, underscoring continued pressure on advanced chip supply. That matters for enterprises because tight wafer supply can keep AI hardware expensive and delay infrastructure rollouts.
